
**This version of AttRisk has been built using data from randomised controlled trials of type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Future versions will incorporate data from trials of other index conditions.**

<br>

AttRisk is an interactive application for examining the risk of participant attrition **for control arms (e.g. placebo)** at the design and conduct stages of randomised controlled trials.

<br>

For each stage users can do the following:

-   **Trial design:** Create a hypothetical randomised controlled trial with a specific set of features (e.g., duration, phase, treatment type) and explore how attrition is expected to occur over time.

-   **Trial conduct:** Extend this investigation by assessing how attrition may vary in a hypothetical trial enrolling participants with a particular set of characteristics (e.g., age, sex, race/ethnicity).

<br>

**Glossary of sidebar items**

-   **Home** - Welcome page

-   **User guide** - Guides for using AttRisk

-   **Trial design** - Predict attrition risk during trial design

-   **Trial conduct** - Predict attrition risk during trial conduct

-   **About** - Contact details and information about the motivations and team behind AttRisk

<br>

To get started, we recommend first exploring the **User guide**, which provides an overview of the interface, inputs, interpreting outputs and example use cases for each stage.
